_comment: Canned replies for scripts/stub_llm.py, keyed by rule so the
evals-offline CI gate (scripts/run_evals.py) is fully hermetic.
Every rule here exists to satisfy exactly one case in
case so a failure is traceable back to its source. Rules use a
short, distinctive substring from that case's `input` as `match` so
they can never accidentally fire for a DIFFERENT case's input (see
scripts/stub_llm.py::select_reply — first full match wins). Adding a
new eval case means adding a new rule here, or it silently falls
through to `default` and probably fails its expected_contains check.
default: I'm a stub assistant with no fixture rule matching this request.
